# tarca

> A zero-dependency TypeScript client for the Billingo API v3 (Hungarian invoicing), the sibling of kassza (Számlázz.hu). Status 0.x: all 57 Billingo operations are implemented (invoices, proformas, advance invoices, receipts, cancellations, modification documents, payments, PDFs, partners, products, inventory, document blocks, bank accounts, spendings, exports) and run in a live end-to-end test on a Billingo developer test profile. Exactly-once issuing with `createOnce` and a `vendorId`. Ships TypeScript types for every Billingo schema, generated from the official OpenAPI spec and corrected where the live API differs, and `tarca/testing` (an in-memory fake Billingo and a mock client). Retries only GET requests, never writes. Runs on Node 22+, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers and Vercel Edge. Independent open-source project, not a Billingo product.
